why: SA5011's remaining entry here is the *missing* one (sa5011/ok/ok.go:89) — upstream reports it and guff does not; the two sigma directions guff now models (`sigma_shadows`, and `renamed_before_check` added 2026-08-13, which closed both consul allowlist entries) are about *not* reporting; SA6001 recall; SA1023/SA4020 position and text; SA4015/SA4031/SA5005/SA9004 precision. The Go stdlib error text that used to head this list is gone: SA1000, SA1001, SA1002 and SA1007 are all ports now, in crates/guff-staticcheck/src/gostd/. SA1011's recall is gone from this list too (missing 9 -> 7, 2026-08-10): it asked whether a constant was valid UTF-8 while the constant layer held it as Rust text, so the answer was always yes. SA9008's pattern matches upstream exactly; what remains there is its IR verification (docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §4, 2026-08-09). SA1019 left this list on 2026-08-12 (missing 7 -> 5, extra 9 -> 7): it reported at the selected name instead of the start of the selector (upstream hands `report.Report` the whole `*ast.SelectorExpr`), and the deprecation message was trimmed while upstream's `strings.Replace(alt, "\\n", " ", -1)` leaves the trailing space that `doc.Text()` puts there. SA4006's interface-boxing extra left this list on 2026-08-13 (extra 7 -> 6): guff-ssa's `MakeInterface` now carries the boxed value, so `i = n` into an `interface{}` gives `n` a referrer.
target: 0/0 — see docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §4 (2026-08-09) for the remaining classes.
